summary: With the Intelligent China webpage launching this week, the team is racing to finalize its promotional push alongside Asia Star while resolving a persistent Outlook lockout and advancing the Knowledge website redesign.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the Intelligent China webpage launch this week, which will finally allow optimization alongside Asia Star as the two flagship programs for visibility and lead generation; US partner programs, including Berkeley as a possible third, remain secondary. Urgent this week: the team must resolve the Outlook account lockout by re-logging in on all devices and confirming backend unlock with CKGSB, and Joseph needs to deliver the target-audience research and Google Ads conversion-tracking brief so the audit can proceed. The Knowledge website redesign is moving forward with the current design as the base, incorporating editorial-style layout inspiration, a two-menu structure, and BCI/BSI indices—Joseph to share the HTML file and hold a feedback session with Julie and the team lead. Looking ahead, the Greater Marcom department meeting on November 30 and the award-status press release update (Tian Xuefang) are on the horizon, while the English obituary for Professor Jon Liao and PRME password change remain pending.

decisions.text: Re-login accounts on all devices to prevent repeated lockouts from stale credentials.
Remove the standalone videos section and disperse videos by topic instead.
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge menu and School menu) at the top.
Bring BCI and BSI indices into the Knowledge section, similar to the school homepage banner.
Do not display a stock-market ticker at the top of the page.
Use the current Knowledge design as the base, taking selected inspiration from Joseph's editorial-style layout.
Asia Star and Intelligent China are the top two promotional priorities; US partner programs are secondary.
Berkeley will be considered as a possible third priority and included in the audit phase.
Intelligent China webpage launches this week, enabling optimization alongside Asia Star.
Use English name only (Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business) on the potential award, consistent with last year's approach.
